answer: Guarantor admission with joint slashing tends to deter bulk forgery. A sponsor typically locks 200 units for 15 epochs and may endorse at most 2 newcomers per epoch, while each newcomer locks 100 units for 6 epochs. When a juniper audit confirms forgery, the newcomer is slashed in full and the sponsor loses 50% of the stake plus sponsorship rights for 10 epochs. A copper-stamped graph exposes star clusters and any karst of fake sponsors. Cost math: 1,000 clones need 500 clean sponsors risking 100,000 units, and with 30% caught the joint loss exceeds 45,000 units.
